mechanism: Ciprofloxacin may increase lisdexamfetamine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and potential renal tubular reabsorption effects, while amphetamines may increase fluoroquinolone CNS penetration and seizure risk.
action: Monitor for increased amphetamine effects (tachycardia, hypertension, tremor, insomnia) and QT prolongation; consider alternative antibiotic if possible or use with caution and dose adjustment.
